svr.forecast_function: r2h.annual_expanding.fit.forecast_year policy A (unchanged); context = all valid returns before the refit date
svr.history_shorter_than_window: use all available history, flag HISTORY_TRUNCATED (identical to expanding on that segment)

cusum.rolling_reset_semantics: window may not reach before the last reset date; first w-1 days after a reset = WINDOW_NOT_AVAILABLE

page.state: S_t = max(0, S_{t-1} + increment); NaN residual -> state carried
page.post_alarm: state set to 0 on the day after an alarm (POST_ALARM_RESET)
page.two_sided: alarm if upper or lower crosses its own threshold; thresholds jointly calibrated

cusum.posthoc: r2h.paper2020.cusum_squares_test on the whole 2020-2025 valid residual path (POSTHOC_ONLY) + per calendar year
cusum.raw_variance_alternative: rolling_cusum applied to raw returns (no SVR standardization)

time_splits_E1.annual_shifted_placebo: annual starts shifted by +21, +63, +126 evaluation trading days (2020 start kept)

changepoints_E4.information: score at t uses returns/prices up to close t only; threshold = quantile of the rule's own scores strictly before t (expanding, min 120 prior scores, warm-up 2019)
changepoints_E4.application: trigger confirmed at close t -> reset/refit takes effect from t+1
changepoints_E4.edge: trigger only on entry into exceedance (no repeat while the score stays above threshold)

P_price_slope.score: OLS slope of log price over [t-L+1,t] minus the same over [t-2L+1,t-L]; strength = abs; direction = sign

V_volatility.score: ln(var(r[t-L+1..t]) / var(r[t-2L+1..t-L])) (ddof=1); variants two_sided |score|, expansion score>0, contraction -score>0

M_moving_average.score: gap_t = ln(MA_s/MA_l) of Close; change = gap_t - gap_{t-s}; strength = abs; cross flag = sign(gap_t) != sign(gap_{t-1})

K_kurtosis.score: excess kurtosis of r over [t-L+1,t] minus over [t-2L+1,t-L]; strength = abs; winsorized 1/99 variant recorded for outlier influence

changepoints_E4.primary_rule_for_reset_refit: V20 two_sided q0.99 gap20 (fixed before results)

placebos.calendar: same number of resets, evenly spaced over evaluation days
placebos.random: same number of resets, uniform dates with the same refractory gap, 200 draws
placebos.shifted: trigger dates circularly shifted within the evaluation period by a uniform offset, 200 draws

svr_policy_E6_E10.E10_adaptive_window: on primary-rule triggers (V20 two_sided q0.95 gap20): strength past-percentile >= 0.995 -> refit trailing 252; >= 0.99 -> 504; >= 0.95 -> 756; scheduled annual expanding refits unchanged

calibration_E11.null_dgp: GARCH(1,1)-t (r2h.joint_cusum.dcc.fit_garch_t) fitted to 2019-01-03..2020-12-30 returns (lock-2; lock-1 2019-only fit was degenerate alpha=0, beta=0.0008 = iid t, kept as N0); simulated on the real 2019-2025 calendar; full pipeline re-run per path
calibration_E11.false_alarm_metric: probability of >=1 alarm day in a calendar-year block (2021..2025 blocks) under the null
calibration_E11.null_validity_checks: per year: mean e^2, excess kurtosis, Ljung-Box Q(10) on e^2, ARCH-LM(5); observed outside null central 99% in any year -> NULL_MODEL_INVALID for confirmatory p-values
calibration_E11.null_dgp_rule: prefer fit window ending 2020-12-30 (no data from the 2021-2025 false-alarm blocks); fall back to 2019-2025 only if a parameter is on a bound (alpha<=1e-4, beta<=1e-4, persistence>=0.999-1e-4, nu at its limits)

synthetic.base: GARCH(1,1)-t fitted to 2019-2020 (same as null, lock-2); same base innovations for rep i across scenarios (paired)
synthetic.change_window: tau uniform over evaluation days 2021-03-02..2025-09-30 unless stated

scenarios.S01_var_x1.5: variance x1.5 from tau to end
scenarios.S02_var_x2: variance x2 from tau to end
scenarios.S03_var_x3: variance x3 from tau to end
scenarios.S05_long_persistent: variance x2 for 120 days then back
scenarios.S06_gradual: variance multiplier ramps 1->3 over 60 days, then stays
scenarios.S08_one_day_extreme: one return of -8 unconditional sd at tau
scenarios.S09_up_then_down: variance x3 for 40 days then back to x1
scenarios.S10_repeated: x2 at tau, x1 at tau+60, x2 at tau+120, x1 at tau+180
scenarios.S11_year_boundary: variance x2 from 5 trading days before a random year end (2020..2024) to end
scenarios.S12_var_x0.5: variance x0.5 from tau to end

synthetic.multiplier_semantics: r_t = mu + sqrt(m_t) * (GARCH-t innovation path); GARCH recursion unchanged
synthetic.detection: first alarm day in [tau, tau+H]; delay = alarm - tau; delay summarized only over detected reps; pre-tau alarms reported separately

compute.gpu_scope: batched rolling/Page CUSUM and null quantiles over stored residual arrays; float64 reference on CPU
compute.precision_rule: any alarm flip between CPU float64 and GPU -> NUMERICAL_DISAGREEMENT, GPU result not used
